notes.title: 🌧️ Open when your day feels too heavy
notes.body: Dada, sagla ekach veli handle karaychi garaj nahiye re. Kahi divas kharach khup heavy astat, kahi goshti explain karaychahi man nast. Pan please swatahla saglyasathi blame karat basu nakos. Tula pratyek veli strong rahaychi garaj nahiye. Aaj fakt divas sampav, thoda rest ghe, baki sagla halu halu baghu. Tula sagla ektyane handle karaychi garaj nahiye, samajla? Ani ho, tu kahi bolala nahis tari chalel, mi ugach dokyala khayla present aahech. 🫂

notes.title: 🌧️ Open when you've had a really bad day
notes.body: Aree Dadaaa, kay zala aaj? Divas kharab gela mhanun saglach kharab aahe asa nast na re. Kahi lok, kahi goshti ani kahi situations aplyala khup thakvun taktat. Pan ek bad day mhanje bad life nahi. Aaj kahi jamla nasel, kahi chukla asel tari it's okay. Udya punha try karta yeil. Ata swatahla thoda break de. Ani please sagla manaat thevun swatahlach punish karu nakos. Tujhyasathi ek chhoti shi reminder: tu fakt saglyansathi kahi kartos mhanun important nahiyes, tu ahes mhanun important ahes. ❤️

notes.title: 🌀 Open when you're overthinking
notes.body: Dada, thamb jara. Ekach veli saglya goshtincha answer shodhaycha prayatna nako karus. Je zala te zala, je ajun zalele nahi tyacha aatach vichar karun swatahla stress kashala detos? Ek thought at a time, okay? Swatahla vichar ki, “Mi atta kharach kahi solve kartoy ka, ki fakt tyach goshtila punha punha dokyat firavtoy?” Je tujhya control madhe aahe tyavar laksh de. Baki sagla atta solve karna compulsory nahiye. Ani ho, tujhya dokyat 100 tabs open astil tar ek tari close kar ata. 😂🤍

notes.title: 🫧 Open when your mind won't stop thinking
notes.body: Dadaaa, please ekda shant bas ani swatahla thoda vel de. Pratyek goshticha hidden meaning shodhaychi garaj nahi, pratyek message punha punha vachaychi garaj nahi, ani pratyek situation cha worst possible ending imagine karaychihi garaj nahi. Sometimes goshti fakt jasya aahet tasya asu shaktat. Tula sagla aajch samajla pahije asa kahi rule nahiye. Paani pi, thoda phone side la thev, breathe kar ani ekach goshtivar focus kar. Tujha mind thakla asel tar tyala ajun questions deun nako thakvu. 🩷

notes.title: 😤 Open when you're angry
notes.body: Aree Dada, mahitiye atta khup raag yet asel tula. Ani atta mala kahi sangaycha mood nasel tari chalel. Fakt raagaat swatahla kiwa dusryanna hurt hoil asa kahi bolu nakos, okay? Thoda vel ghe, shant ho, mag tharav kay karaychay te. Tula pratyek goshtila lagech reply dyaychi garaj nahi. Ani ho, atta majhyavar raag kadhaycha asel tar aadhi notice de, karan mi pan kami nahiye. 😂 Pan seriously, raag yene okay aahe, fakt tya raagaat swatahla ajun tras karun gheu nakos.

notes.title: 🥹 Open when you feel like nobody understands you
notes.body: Dada, kadhi kadhi aaplyala swatahlach samjavta yet nahi ki nemka kay hotay, tar dusryanna kasa samajnar na? Pan tyacha arth asa nahi ki tujhya feelings matter karat nahit. Tula pratyek gosht explain karta aali pahije asa nahi. Kahi vela fakt “aaj mood nahiye” evdhach bolayla jamta, and that's okay. Tula sagla perfect words madhe sangaychi garaj nahi. Ani majhyashi bolaycha asel tar bol, nahi bolaycha asel tari chalel. Mi pratyek veli solution gheun basnar nahi, kadhi kadhi fakt aikayla pan aahe. 🤍

notes.title: 🥺 Open when you feel like you're becoming a burden
notes.body: Aree Dadaaa, ek gosht lakshat thev. Tula kahi problem aahe mhanun tu burden hot nahiyes. Tula pan bad days yetat, tula pan support lagto, ani tula pan kadhi kadhi konitari aikun ghyava asa vatnarach na. Tu nehmi saglyanna samjun ghetos mhanun tula nehmi sagla ektyane samjun ghyaycha asa nahiye. Pan ho, saglyanna tyanchya limits astat, mhanun ekmekanna space denahi important aahe. Fakt itkach, swatahla unwanted samjun gheu nakos. Tujhyahi feelings na jagaa aahe. 🫶🏻

notes.title: 🥲 Open when you feel like you're not doing enough
notes.body: Dada, tu swatahkadun khup expectations thevto ka re? Kadhi kadhi aapan itka pudhcha vichar karto ki aajparyant kay kay kelay te disatch nahi. Tula sagla ekdam perfect karaychi garaj nahi. Slow progress pan progress asto. Aaj fakt ek gosht changli keli asel tari ti count hote. Pratyek divas productive asaylach hava asa nahi. Tu machine nahiyes re baba. Thoda jag, thoda has, thoda rest ghe. Sagla prove karaychya nadat swatahsathi jagaychach visru nakos. ❤️

notes.title: 🫠 Open when you feel emotionally exhausted
notes.body: Dada, mentally thakna pan kharach thakna asta re. Baherun sagla normal disat asla tari aatmadhe khup kahi chalu asu shakta. Aaj saglyanna reply dyaycha mood nasel, bolaycha nasel, kiwa fakt shant basavasa vatat asel tar thik aahe. Thoda break ghe. Tujhya feelings la ignore karun satat busy rahaychi garaj nahi. Ani lakshat thev, rest ghen mhanje give up karna nahi. Sometimes pause ghetlyavarach pudhcha step clear hoto. 🩷

notes.title: 🥹 Open when you forget how much you matter
notes.body: Dada, he nit vach ekda. TU MATTER KARTOS, okay? Fakt konala help kartos mhanun nahi, konala hasavtos mhanun nahi, kiwa konasathi available ahes mhanun nahi. Tujhi swatahchi value aahe. Tu pan chukto, tu pan confuse hoto, tu pan kadhi kadhi chidto, pan tyamule tu kami important hot nahiyes. Tu perfect nahiyes, ani tula perfect vhaychihi garaj nahi. Tujhya presence ne kahi lokanchya life madhe farak padto, kadachit tula te nehmi disat nasel. Ani majhya life madhe tar tuzi ek veglich jagaa aahe re. Bas, aajpurta evdhach lakshat thev. 🫂❤️

notes.title: 🥺 Open when you feel lonely
notes.body: Dada, lonely vatna mhanje tujhya around konich nahi asa nahi. Kahi vela khup lok astana pan aplyala konitari genuinely samjun ghyava asa vatat. Ani te feeling valid aahe. Swatahla force karu nakos ki “mala kahi farak padat nahi.” Farak padat asel tar padto. Tula bolaycha asel tar bol, konala call karavasa vatla tar kar, kiwa fakt thoda vel swatahsobat ghalav. Pan saglyanpasun completely disconnect hou nakos. Ek chhota message suddha kadhi kadhi enough asto. 🤍

notes.title: 🫣 Open when you don't feel like talking to anyone
notes.body: Okay Dada, aaj bolaycha mood nahiye? Fine. Mi interview ghenar nahi. 😂 Tula lagech sagla explain karayla kiwa normal act karayla force karnaar nahi. Thoda vel swatahsathi ghe. Fakt evdhach, saglyanna dur thevnyachi garaj vatli tari ekhadyala tari kalu de ki tula space havi aahe. Ani jevha bolavasa vatel tevha bol. Tujha mood thik karaychi responsibility mi ektyane gheu shakat nahi, pan tujhya sobat thoda vel basayla, aikayla ani kahi tari faltu bolun hasvayla nakkich aahe. 😂🤍

notes.title: 😭 Open when you feel like crying
notes.body: Aree Dada, feelings lapavun thevlya mhanje tya kami hot nahit re. Kadhi kadhi khup kahi sathlela asta ani te baher yenyasathi thodi space havi aste. Swatahla judge karu nakos. Tula kay vatatay te accept karayla harakat nahi. Sagla लगेच fix karaychi garaj nahi. Thoda vel ghe, paani pi, shant bas. Nantar jamla tar kay tras detay te samjun gheu. Ani nahi jamla tar te pan okay. Tula pratyek veli “I'm fine” mhanaychi garaj nahiye.

notes.title: 😔 Open when someone hurts you
notes.body: Dada, konitari hurt kela mhanun swatachi value tyanchya behaviour varun tharvu nakos. Kahi vela lok chuktat, misunderstandings hotat, ani kahi vela goshti aplya expectation pramane hot nahit. Tyacha arth tu kami ahes asa nahi. Tula hurt zala asel tar te ignore karaychi garaj nahi, pan raagaat swatahsathi ajun problems create karu nakos. Thoda vel ghe, mag shantpane tharav kay yogya aahe. Ani please, ekach vyaktichya behaviour mule saglyanvarcha vishwas sampvu nakos. Saglyanche experiences same nastat. 🤍

notes.title: 🫂 Open when you need a little reassurance
notes.body: Dada, sagla thik hoil yachi guarantee konich deu shakat nahi, pan sagla ektyane handle karaychi garaj nahiye he nakkich. Tula atta clarity nasel, answers nasतील, kiwa pudhe kay karaycha samjat nasel tari chalel. Ek step ghe, mag pudhcha. Tula aajch sagla kalayla pahije asa nahi. Ani ek gosht, help magna mhanje weak asna nahi. Kahi vela dusryacha perspective aiklyane goshti thodya clear hotat. So please, swatahla saglyat ekta samjun gheu nakos. ❤️

notes.title: 😑 Open when you feel like I'm annoying you
notes.body:
HAHAHAHA DADAAAAA 😭😂

Aadhi tar sorry for being your unpaid full-time notification system. Kahi vela mi jast bolat asen, faltu questions vicharat asen, kiwa ekach gosht 17 vela sangat asen tar mala sang ha. Mi thodi kami karen... THODI mhantle, complete band nahi. 😭

Pan seriously, kadhi tula space havi asel tar mala sangayla harakat nahi. Mi te personally ghenyacha prayatna karnaar nahi. Tu busy asshil, tired asshil, kiwa bolaycha mood nasel tar that's okay. Mala tujhya attention sathi tula force karaycha nahi. Aplya bond madhe space asali tari chalel, fakt misunderstanding nako. Ani ho, mi annoying aahe he mala mahit aahe, pan majhi hi quality return policy madhe accept hot nahi. 😂🫶🏻

notes.title: 🥹 Open when you think I'm upset with you
notes.body: Aree Dada, mi kadhi shant asen, mood off asel, kiwa thodi vegli vagat asen tar lagech sagla swatahsobat relate karu nakos. Kadhi kadhi majhyahi dokyat veglya goshti chalu astat. Ani kahi misunderstanding zali tar guess karat basnyapeksha mala vichar. Aapan doghehi mind readers nahiyot re baba. 😂 Mala kahi vatla asel tar mi sangaycha prayatna karen, ani tula kahi vatla tar tu pan sang. Pratyek gosht perfect asnyapeksha aapan ekmekanshi honestly bolu shaklo tar te jast important aahe. ❤️

notes.title: 😂 Open when you need some fun
notes.body:
DADAAAAA, emotional department aaj band aahe. 😂

Aajcha task:
1. Swatahla thoda break dyaycha.
2. Ek faltu meme baghaycha.
3. Karan nastana hasaycha.
4. Majhe messages vachun “hi mulgi normal kadhi honar?” asa vicharaycha.
5. Ani mag swatahla samjavaycha ki hi mulgi majhya dokyacha permanent software update aahe. 😭😂

Chal ata serious face side la thev. Saglya problems na aaj ek divas holiday de. Aaj fakt thoda chill kar. Ani ho, majhyashi bhandayla alaas tar lakshat thev, majhyakade faltu arguments cha unlimited stock aahe. 😌

notes.title: 🤭 Open when you need a reason to smile
notes.body:
Aree Dadaaa, smile kar na thodi. Nahi tar mi majhe embarrassing moments athavun denar aahe. 😭😂

Athavtay ka, aapan kiti faltu goshtinvar bolat basto? Kiti vela serious conversation suru hote ani madhyech kahi tari stupid nighat. Kiti vela ek simple gosht pan aapan ugach complicated karto. Aplya daily bakbakit kahi special asel tar te mhanje ti agdi normal astana pan aplyala hasavte. So atta ek chhoti shi smile de. Full happy asaychi garaj nahi, fakt thodasa mood halka kar. Ani smile nahi aali tar thik aahe, majha joke flop zala asa samju. 😂❤️

notes.title: 🥹 Open when you miss the old happy days
notes.body: Dada, kahi moments athavle ki hasu pan yet ani thodasa emotional pan vhayla hota na? Karan kahi goshti aplyasathi important astat. Aplya memories madhe sagla perfect nasel, pan kahi moments nakkich special aahet. Aapan haslo, faltu bollo, ekmekanna chidavla, kahi goshti share kelya. Tya memories chi value aahe. Ani pratyek divas agdi tasach asayla pahije asa nahi. Bond badaltat, routines badaltat, life madhe vegveglya goshti yetat. Pan changlya memories athavun smile karayla harakat nahi. 🤍

notes.title: 🧠 Open when you're confused about a decision
notes.body: Dada, atta decision ghyaycha asel tar ek minute thamb. Swatahla vichar: mala kharach kay pahije? Konta option practical aahe? Ani mi ha decision raagaat, pressure madhe, ki shantpane ghettoy? Saglyanna happy thevnyasathi swatahla completely ignore karu nakos. Pan swatahcha vichar kartana dusryanvar honara result pan bagh. Donhi goshti important aahet. Ek paper gheun pros-cons lihun bagh, mag decide kar. Ani lakshat thev, perfect decision milalach pahije asa nahi; vichar karun ghetlela reasonable decision pan enough asto. 🫶🏻

notes.title: 💭 Open when you're blaming yourself
notes.body: Dada, ekda chuk zali mhanun swatahla satat punish karat basaycha ka? Chuk zali asel tar ti accept kar, shakya asel tithe sudhar, ani tyatun shik. Pan ekach gosht punha punha athavun swatahla vait feel karvat rahilas tar problem solve honar nahi. Tu tujhya mistakes peksha motha ahes. Swatahsathi pan thodi kindness thev. Dusryane chuk keli tar tyala samjun ghyaycha prayatna kartos na? Tasa ekda swatahkade pan bagh. Sagla excuse karaycha nahi, pan swatahla improve karaychi chance dyaychi. ❤️

notes.title: 🫶 Open when you need someone to listen
notes.body: Dada, aaj advice nahi, lecture nahi, solutions nahi. Fakt bolaycha asel tar bol. Tula sagla sequence madhe explain karta ala nahi tari chalel. Madhye madhye thambla tari chalel. Mala sagla mahit asaylach pahije asa nahi, ani pratyek problem solve karta aali pahije asa pan nahi. Kadhi kadhi manaatla thodasa baher padla tari halka vatata. Ani jar atta bolaycha nasel tar te pan okay. Tujhya pace ne. No pressure. 🤍

notes.title: 🌱 Open when you're scared of the future
notes.body: Dada, future cha vichar karna normal aahe, pan future cha stress gheta gheta present purnapane miss karu nakos. Sagla kasa honar, kon sobat asnar, kay badalnar, kay nahi — ya saglyanchi answers aaj milnar nahit. Ani te okay aahe. Tu atta je karu shaktoys tyavar focus kar. Ek chhota step, ek decision, ek divas at a time. Tula sampurna rasta disaychi garaj nahi, pudhcha step disla tari enough aahe. Swatahkadun saglyanche answers aajch magu nakos. 🩷

notes.title: 🥺 Open when you feel unappreciated
notes.body: Dada, tu je kartos tyachi pratyek veli koni appreciation karelach asa nahi. Kahi vela lokanna aaplyasathi koni kay kelay he lakshat yayla vel lagto. Pan tyamule tu kelelya efforts chi value kami hot nahi. Fakt saglyanna samjun ghetana swatahla completely visru nakos. Tula pan thank you aikayla avdel, tula pan konitari tujhya efforts chi jaan thevavi asa vatel, ani te normal aahe. Tula saglyansathi det rahaychach aahe asa nahi. Tu pan receive karayla deserve kartos — care, respect ani understanding. 🤍

notes.title: 🧸 Open when you need to feel cared for
notes.body:
Dada, tu nehmi sagla handle karaycha prayatna kartos, pan kadhi kadhi konitari “jevlays ka?”, “thakla asshil na?”, “kay zala?” asa vicharava he pan important asta. So he ghe, majhyakadun ek chhota care check. Jevlays ka? Paani pilyas ka? Thoda rest ghetlas ka? Ani saglyat important, swatahla kasa feel hotay te ekda vicharlas ka? 😭❤️

Majhya kadun mothmothya speeches naslya tari chalel, pan tu swatachi kalji ghyavi he nakkich vatata. Ani ho, tu jevha mala ulat “tu jevlis ka?” vichartos na, tevha answer denyachya aadhi tu swatah jevlela aslas tar jast changla. 😂

notes.title: 😶 Open when you can't explain what you're feeling
notes.body: Dada, saglya feelings na naav deta yetach asa nahi. Kahi vela raag, sadness, confusion, disappointment sagla ekatra asta ani nemka kay hotay te kalat nahi. Tula atta lagech answer shodhaychi garaj nahi. Thoda vel ghe ani swatahkade laksh de. Kay jast bother kartay te halu halu clear hoil. Ani nahi zala tari help magta yete. Swatahla “mala asa ka vatatay?” mhanun judge karu nakos. Feelings samjun ghyayla time lagla tari chalel. 🤍

notes.title: 🌻 Open when something good happens
notes.body:
AREEEEE DADAAAAA, KAY ZALA SANG LAVKAR!! 😭❤️

Aaj kahi chhan zala asel tar please te enjoy kar. Lagech pudhcha target, pudhchi problem, pudhcha stress nako. Thoda celebrate kar na re! Chhoti achievement asli tari ti tujhich aahe. Ani mala sangayla visarlas tar mag bagh, mi naraz honar nahi... fakt 46 questions vicharen ki mala aadhi ka nahi sangitlas. 😂

Seriously, good things share karayla pan jagaa havi life madhe. Tula je chhan vatla te enjoy kar. Tu happy aslas ki mala pan chhan vatata, evdhach. 🫶🏻

notes.title: 🤍 Open when we haven't talked properly
notes.body: Dada, aajkal bolna kami zala asel, doghe busy asu, kiwa kahi divas proper conversation zali nasel tari it's okay. Pratyek bond la pratyek divas same amount of time deta yet nahi. Mala fakt asa vatta ki aapan busy aslo tari ekmekanshi normal rahu shaklo pahije. Bolayla kahi special topic lagayla nako ani silence ala mhanun lagech kahi chuklay asa pan samju naye. Jevha time milel tevha bolu, faltu bakbak karu, ekmekanna update deu. No pressure, no unnecessary overthinking. ❤️

notes.title: 🫂 Open when we have a misunderstanding
notes.body: Dada, aapan doghehi vegveglya goshti vegveglya paddhatine samju shakto. Kahi vela mi kahi bolen ani tu vegla meaning ghesheel, kiwa tu kahi bolshil ani mala veglach vatel. Pan ek misunderstanding zali mhanun lagech worst assume karaycha nahi. Shantpane bolun clear karta yet asel tar karu. Chuk konachi hoti yachyapeksha pudhe kay better karta yeil te pan baghu. Mala saglya goshtinvar agree karaychi garaj nahi, pan ekmekanna samjun ghyaycha prayatna nakkich karaycha aahe. 🤍

notes.title: 🥹 Open when you feel like giving up on a difficult task
notes.body: Dada, atta jamat nahiye mhanun kadhi jamnarach nahi asa nahi. Thoda break ghe, problem la veglya angle ne bagh, kiwa konachi help ghe. Ekach goshtivar khup vel adkun rahilas tar mind ajun frustrated hota. Chhota step gheun suruvat kar. Aaj sagla complete nahi zala tari chalel. Progress mhanje pratyek veli motha result nahi; kadhi kadhi punha try karna suddha progress asta. Swatahla ek fair chance de, okay? 🌱

notes.title: 😂 Open when you need your little sister's bakbak
notes.body:
DADAAAAA, HA SECTION TUJHYASATHI SPECIAL AAHE. 😭😂

Tula mahit aahe ka, tu shant basla ki mala ajun bolavasa vatata. Tu busy aslas ki mala tech sangaycha asta. Ani tu reply kelas ki mala tyachyavar ajun 3 goshti sangaychya astat. Majha brain asa kaam karto, mi kay karu? 😭

Pan ho, mi tula jast disturb karat asen tar sang. Mi thoda control karen. Thoda mhantle. 😂

Tu mala chidavnar, mi tula chidavnar, tu mala shant bas mhananar ani mi “ek last gosht” mhanun ajun 15 minutes bolnar. Aplya ya faltu routine la kahi logic nahi, pan majhya sathi te chhan aahe. Chal ata ja, paani pi. Ani phone jast vaprat asshil tar to pan thev thoda. 😭🫶🏻

notes.title: 🥹 Open when you wonder whether you make a difference
notes.body: Dada, kadhi kadhi aaplyala aaplya presence cha dusryanvar honara effect kalat nahi. Aapan fakt normal bolto, ekhadi gosht vicharto, konala aikun gheto, kiwa ek chhota gesture karto. Pan dusryasathi tyacha meaning motha asu shakto. Tula pratyek veli tyacha result diselach asa nahi. Mhanun swatahla insignificant samju nakos. Tujhya life chi value fakt tu kiti achieve kartos yavar depend nahi. Tu kasa manus ahes, kasa grow hotoyes, ani swatahsobat dusryanna kasa treat kartoyes he pan important aahe. ❤️

notes.title: 🌙 Open before you sleep
notes.body: Dadaaa, divas kasa pan gela asel, ata thoda rest ghe. Aaj je complete zala nahi te udya baghta yeil. Aaj kahi chukla asel tar udya tyatun shikta yeil. Ata saglya goshti bed var gheun jau nakos. 😂 Phone side la thev, paani pi, ani swatahla ek break de. Tula pratyek ratri sagla solve karunach zopaycha asa rule nahiye. Good night, Dada. Udya ek navin divas asel. Take care of yourself, okay? 🤍🌙

notes.title: ☀️ Open when you wake up feeling low
notes.body:
Good morning, Dadaaa. ❤️

Aaj uthlyavar lagech sagla perfect karaycha pressure nako gheus. Ek-ek gosht kar. Kalcha mood aaj pan carry karaychach asa nahi, ani aaj happy feel zala pahije asa force pan nako karus. Swatahsathi ek chhoti gosht kar, breakfast kar, paani pi ani divas halu halu start kar. Aajcha divas kasa jail te aatach decide karaychi garaj nahi. Just give yourself a fresh start. Ani ho, majha message vachun smile nahi aali tar complaint department madhe jaun complaint kar. 😂

notes.title: 🩷 Open when you need a reminder of our bond
notes.body: Dada, aapla bond majhyasathi fakt daily messages kiwa divasbhar bolnyapurta nahiye. Mala tyat comfort aahe, bakbak aahe, teasing aahe, kadhi serious goshti aahet, kadhi misunderstandings pan astil. Pan mala asa vatta ki aapan ekmekanna honestly bolu shaklo, space deu shaklo, ani garaj asel tevha ekmekanna samjun ghyaycha prayatna karu shaklo tar te important aahe. Aplya bond la pratyek divas prove karaychi garaj nahi. Mala tu nehmi available pahije asa nahi, ani tula majhyasathi sagla side la thevaychi garaj nahi. Fakt aapan ekmekanshi real rahu, bas. 🤍

notes.title: 💌 Open when you want to know what I don't say often
notes.body: Dada, mi roj tula sangt nasel, pan tu majhya life madhe important ahes. Tujhyashi faltu bolna, tujhya goshti aikna, tula chidavna, kadhi serious goshtinvar bolna — he sagla majhyasathi special aahe. Kahi vela mi jast bolte, kahi vela emotional hote, ani kahi vela nemka kay bolaycha te pan kalat nahi. Pan ek gosht khari aahe: mala tu changla rahava asa manapasun vatata. Tujha stress kami vhava, tu swatachi kalji ghyavi, ani tula pan life madhe chhan moments milavet. Tula saglyansamor strong disaychi garaj nahi. Tu fakt tu raha. ❤️

notes.title: 🫶 Open when you need a tiny reminder to take care of yourself
notes.body:
Dada, checklist time! 😂

- Jevlas ka?
- Paani pilyas ka?
- Khup velapasun phone var tar nahiyes na?
- Thoda rest ghetlas ka?
- Swatahla ugach blame tar karat nahiyes na?
- Saglyancha vichar karta karta swatahla visarla tar nahiyes na?

Aata saglyanchi answer dyaychi garaj nahi, pan swatahsathi ek tari gosht kar. Ani ho, tu mala “tu pan kar” mhannar he mahit aahe, mhanun mi pan karen. Happy? 😭😂🤍

notes.title: 🥹 Open when you feel like no one notices your efforts
notes.body: Dada, saglyanna sagla diselach asa nahi. Kahi goshti tu quietly handle kartos, kahi stress tu swatahpurta thevtos, kahi efforts cha result lagech disat nahi. Pan swatahsathi tu ekda acknowledge kar ki tu prayatna kartoyes. Sagla perfect nasla tari tu try kartoyes, he pan matter karta. Ani jithe appreciation milat nahi tithe swatachi value visru nakos. Tula fakt dusryanna prove karat rahaychay asa nahi. Tula swatahsathi pan ek changla, peaceful life build karaycha aahe. One step at a time, Dada. ❤️

notes.title: 🧸 Open when you need a little virtual hug
notes.body:
Aree Dadaaa, he ghe ek virtual hug. 🫂

Aaj sagla explain karaycha nahi, saglyanna reply dyaycha nahi, saglyansamor strong disaycha nahi. Thoda vel fakt swatahsathi ghe. Tula atta je vatatay te lagech badlayla pahije asa nahi. Thoda vel de swatahla. Ani lakshat thev, support magayla harakat nahi. Tula sagla ektyane handle karaychi garaj nahiye. Aajcha divas tough asel tar tyala tough mhanayla harakat nahi. Udya punha baghu. Aata fakt breathe kar ani thoda relax ho. 🤍

notes.title: 💌 When he opens the website for no reason
notes.body:
Areee Dada, tu ikde kasa kay? 😂

Kahi special reason nahiye. Fakt tu website open keli mhanun sangavasa vatla ki hi sagli bakbak tujhya sathi aahe. Tula heavy vatat asel tevha, mood changla asel tevha, kiwa fakt timepass karaycha asel tevha ikde ye. Pratyek message vachaychi garaj nahi. Je atta tujhya mood la match hotay te open kar. Ani ho, website banavnyasathi mi evdha vichar kela mhanun mala ek tari compliment milala pahije. 😭😂❤️

notes.title: 🌼 When he needs to remember the little things
notes.body: Dada, life madhe saglya goshti mothya achievements nasतात. Kadhi ek changli conversation, kadhi konitari vicharleli simple gosht, kadhi faltu joke, kadhi shantpane ghalavlela vel — ya little things pan important astat. Satat pudhe kay karaycha yachach vichar kartana aaj kay chhan aahe te miss karu nakos. Tula pratyek divas memorable banvaychi garaj nahi. Kahi normal divas pan nantar athavle ki special vatatat. Thoda present madhe raha, okay? 🤍

notes.title: 🧡 When he needs to hear that asking for help is okay
notes.body: Dada, help magaychi vel aali tar mag. Sagla swatahla kalayla pahije, sagla swatahla handle karta ala pahije, saglyanna answers deta ale pahijet — asa kahi nahi. Kahi goshti aplyala ektyane samjat nahit, ani dusryashi bollyane clarity milu shakte. Trustworthy vyaktishi bol, garaj asel tar advice ghe, kiwa fakt aikun ghyayla sang. Tula sagla perfect karaycha nahiye. Tula swatahsathi yogya goshti shodhaychya aahet. Ani te kartana support ghenyat kahi chuk nahi. 🫶🏻

notes.title: 🤍 When he feels he has to keep everyone happy
notes.body: Dada, saglyanna happy thevaycha prayatna kartana swatahla completely side la thevu nakos. Tu pratyek problem solve karu shakat nahiyes, pratyekala samjavun sangu shakat nahiyes, ani pratyek gosht tujhya responsibility madhe yet nahi. Tu care karu shaktoys, support deu shaktoys, pan saglyanchya feelings cha complete control tujhya hatat nahi. Swatachi peace pan important aahe. Kahi vela “atta mala jamnar nahi” mhanne pan okay aahe. Good person asnyasathi swatahla satat exhaust karaychi garaj nahi. ❤️

notes.title: 🌷 When he needs a fresh start
notes.body: Dada, navin suruvat karayla Monday, new month, new year kiwa kahi perfect moment lagat nahi. Kadhi kadhi ek normal divas pan enough asto. Kal kahi chukla asel tar aaj thoda better try kar. Kal mood off hota mhanun aaj pan tasach asel asa nahi. Ani aaj sagla jamla nahi tari udya punha chance aahe. Swatahla change karayla vel de. Small steps, realistic expectations ani thodi patience. Tu ekach divsat sagla badlaycha prayatna karu nakos. Haluhalu pan pudhe jata yet. 🌱

notes.title: 😂 When he thinks he's always right
notes.body:
DADAAAAA, he section vachnyapurvi ego baher thev. 😭😂

Tu nehmi barobar asshil asa nahi, ani mi nehmi chukichich asen asa pan nahi. Donhi jana kadhi kadhi faltu stubborn hotat, he accept kar. 😂 Kahi vela argument jinknyapeksha samorcha manus kay sangtoy te samjun ghen jast important asta. Ani ho, tu barobar asshil tar mi accept karen... thoda vel lagel pan karen. 😭

Chal ata ja, world peace sathi aaj ek argument kami kar. Majhyapasun suruvat karaychi asel tar mi ready aahe. (Maybe.) 😂❤️

notes.title: 🩷 When he needs to remember his little sister is growing too
notes.body: Dada, mi kadhi khup childish vagte, kadhi faltu emotional hote, kadhi jast bolte, kadhi mala swatahlach kay vatatay te kalat nahi. Pan mi pan halu halu goshti samjun ghyayla shiktey. Mi chukle tar mala samjav, pan mala pan majhya goshti bolaychi space de. Aapan doghehi pratyek veli perfect respond karu asa nahi. Pan ekmekankadun shikat rahilo tar chhan hoil. Mala tujhya kadun sagle answers nako aahet; kadhi kadhi fakt tu majha point aikun ghyava evdhach asta. 🤍

notes.title: 🫂 When he needs to know he doesn't have to pretend with me
notes.body: Dada, majhyashi bolताना pratyek veli “sagla mast aahe” asa dakhvaychi garaj nahi. Tula mood off asel tar te sangta yeil, confusion asel tar te pan, ani bolaycha nasel tar te pan. Mi tula pratyek veli fix karaycha prayatna karen asa nahi. Kadhi kadhi mala pan kay bolaycha te kalnar nahi, pan mi aikaycha prayatna karen. Fakt aapan ekmekanna honestly sangu shaklo ki atta kay jamtay ani kay nahi, tar khup misunderstandings vachtil. No pressure, Dada. ❤️

notes.title: 🥹 When he forgets to appreciate himself
notes.body: Dada, aaj ek minute swatahkade neutral nazrene bagh. Fakt kay chukla, kay kami padla, kay ajun karaycha aahe he nahi. Tu kay shiklas, kuthlya goshtit improve zhalas, kontya difficult situation madhun baher padlas, he pan bagh. Aapan dusryanche good qualities lagech notice karto, pan swatahchya babtit khup strict asto. Thoda balance thev. Swatachi appreciation karna mhanje attitude nahi; te swatachya efforts chi jaan thevna aahe. Ani please, swatahsobat thoda gentle raha. 🤍

notes.title: 💌 One final note for Dada
notes.body:
Dada, hi website banavtana ekach gosht manaat hoti — tula jevha je feel hot asel tevha tyasathi ek chhota message asava. Happy asshil tar hasayla, upset asshil tar thoda halka vatayla, overthinking chalu asel tar jara thambayla, ani swatachi value visarlas tar ti athvayla.

Mi pratyek veli perfect words bolu shakel asa nahi. Kahi vela mi tula irritate pan karen, kahi vela faltu bhanden, kahi vela jast emotional hoen. Pan mala aaplya bond madhe honesty, understanding ani respect asava asa vatta. Aapan doghehi swatachya life madhe grow hou, aapapli kaam karu, pan ekmekanshi bolayla ek comfortable space asavi.

Tula pratyek veli ikde yeun sagle messages vachaychi garaj nahi. Fakt jevha ekhadya message chi garaj vatel tevha open kar. Ani kahi divas tula ya website chi garaj padlich nahi tar te pan chhan — karan tu changla ahes, happy ahes, ani tujhya life madhe chhan goshti ghadat aahet.

**Tu perfect ahes mhanun nahi, tar tu ek manus ahes, tujhya feelings aahet, tujhya goshti aahet, ani tujhya life la value aahe mhanun tu matter kartos.**

Take care of yourself, Dada. Ani ho, tujhya little sister chi bakbak ajun khup baki aahe. 😂❤️

*— Tujhi chhoti, thodi annoying, pan manapasun kalji ghenari bahin.*

letter:
For My Dada, ek chhoti shi gosht… ❤️

Dadaaa,

He letter lihayla basle na, tevha kalat navhta nemka kuthepasun start karu. Karan tujhya baddal lihayla basla ki ekach gosht lihun sampat nahi, ani khup lihayla gele ki tu mhanashil, “Aree bass kar ata, kiti lihites!” 😭😂

Pan aaj thoda shantpane aikun ghe.

Mala mahit nahi ki mi tula saglya goshti perfect words madhye sangte ki nahi, pan tu majhya life madhye ahes hi gosht majhyasathi khup matter karte. Aapla naata fakt roj bolnyapurta nahiye. Aapan kiti vel bolto, kon aadhi message karto, kiwa kon konachi kalji jast gheto, yacha hishob thevaycha nahiye mala. Mala fakt evdhach avadta ki aaplya divasat kitihi kahi chalu asla tari aaplyakade ekmekanshi bolayla kahi na kahi asta.

Kadhi mi faltu goshti gheun yete, kadhi ekach gosht parat parat sangte, kadhi swatachya mood madhye aste, tar kadhi tula vinakaran irritate karte. 😂 Pan ya saglya majhya versions madhye ek gosht same aahe—mi tujhya samor comfortable aste. Mala sagla perfect banvun dakhvaychi garaj vatat nahi, ani majhyasathi hi feeling khup special aahe.

Ani Dada, mala tu nehmi strong rahava asa nahi vatat. Mala tu khara rahava asa vatta. Happy asshil tar manapasun has, upset asshil tar swatahla force karun normal dakhvu nakos, kahi kalat nasel tar thoda vel ghe. Tula pratyek gosht saglyanna explain karaychi garaj nahi. Tu saglyanna samjun ghenyacha prayatna kartos, pan kadhi kadhi konitari tula pan samjun ghyava, hi pan ek simple expectation aahe na.

Mi tujhya life madhlya saglya problems solve karu shakel asa nahi. Tujhya jagi decisions gheu shakat nahi, ani pratyek difficult moment la perfect advice pan deu shakel asa nahi. Pan tujhya ayushyatil pratyek gosht majhya control madhye nasli tari, tujhya baddalchi majhi care fakt sagla changla chalu astana purti nahi. Aaplyat kadhi disagreement zala, kadhi mood off zala, kiwa kadhi ekmekanna samjun ghyayla vel lagla, tari respect ani understanding thevayla mala nehmi important vatel.

He website banavnyamage pan tech hota. Mala tula fakt ek gift dyaycha navhta. Mala asa kahi tari create karaycha hota je tujhya sathi mi swatah banavla aahe—majhya time madhun, majhya ideas madhun, ani majhya manat je hota tyatun. Te perfect nasel, kahi goshti funny astil, kahi thodya emotional astil, pan tyat majha effort aahe. Ani ha effort tula ek gosht sangava asa mala vatla: tu majhyasathi matter kartos, Dada.

Future madhye aaple schedules badaltill, responsibilities vadhatil, kadhi bolayla kami vel milel, ani aapaplya life madhye navin goshti yetil. Pan mala aaplya natyat ekmekanna space deta yavi, ekmekanna respect karta yava, ani garaj padli tar honestly bolta yava, he jast important vatta. Roj sagla same rahilach asa nahi, pan aapan ekmekanshi kasa vagto he aaplya hatat asta.

Ani ho, ata he vachun khup emotional vhaycha nahi. Mi tula letter dilay mhanje tu mala lifetime tease karaycha license milala asa nahi. 😭😂 Tujhyakade already majhya teasing che khup reasons aahet, ajun ek nako!

Bas, shevti evdhach—thank you for being a part of my life, Dada. Majhyasobat hasnyasathi, majhi bakbak aiknyasathi, ani aaplya natyala tyachya swatahchya paddhatine grow hou denyasathi. Mi nehmi perfect sister asen asa nahi, tu nehmi perfect dada asshil asa pan nahi. Pan perfect asnyapeksha genuine rahna mala jast avadta.

He letter vachlyanantar ek gosht lakshat thev: he fakt aajchya divasapurta nahiye. He majhya manat tujhya sathi je aahe tyacha ek chhota part aahe.

Take care of yourself, Dada. Ani ho, website avadli tar compliment dyaycha visru nakos. Itka effort kela aahe, thoda appreciation tar bantoch! 😂❤️

— Tujhi choti, ji tula disturb karna band karnaar nahiye anytime soon. 🫶🏻
last:
OHHH DADAAA… ONE LAST THING ❤️

Aree, tu itheparyant aalas mhanje website chi full checking chalu aahe vatata. 😂

Pan ata thoda seriously…

Mi tula roj pratyek gosht sangte asa nahi. Kahi vela faltu bakbak karte, kahi vela chidavte, kahi vela swatachya goshtit adakte. Pan ya saglyachya madhye ek gosht aahe ji mala tula sangaychi hoti.

Thank you, Dada. Majhya life cha ek part aslyabaddal. Majhyashi faltu bolnyapasun serious goshti aiknyaparyant, aaplya chhota chhota moments pasun aapan ekmekanna samjun ghenyachya prayatnaparyant — ya saglyala majhyasathi value aahe.

Mi tujhya saglya problems solve karu shakat nahi, tujhya mood cha remote majhyakade nahi, ani tula pratyek veli hasvayla pan jamel asa nahi. 😭😂 Pan mala tu swatachi kalji ghyavi, swatahla unnecessary stress deu naye, ani tujhya life madhe tujhya sathi pan jagava asa manapasun vatta.

Aapan doghehi kadhi chuku, kadhi misunderstand hou, kadhi ekmekanna irritate karu. Pan perfect asnyapeksha ekmekanshi honest rahna, ekmekanchya boundaries samjun ghena ani respect thevna mala jast important vatta.

Ani ek last gosht…

Tula kadhi asa vatla ki tujhya life madhe sagla complicated zala aahe, tar he lakshat thev — tujhya saglya problems peksha tu motha ahes. Tula sagla ektyane carry karaychi garaj nahi. Tula rest gheta yeto, help magta yete, navin suruvat karta yete, ani kadhi kahi kalat nasel tari halu halu shikta yeta.

He website fakt ek bunch of messages nahiye. Hi majhi chhoti shi way aahe tula sangaychi ki tu majhyasathi important ahes, ani tujhya feelings la pan space aahe.

Ata ja, khup emotional karu nakos mala. 😭

Ani ho, website avadli asel tar compliment de. Nahi avadli tari de, karan effort bagh aadhi! 😂🫶🏻

Take care, Dada. Swatahsathi pan thoda vel kadh. You matter, even on the days you forget it. ❤️

— Tujhi little sister, ji ajunhi tula thoda jastach disturb karnaar aahe. 😂
